Primary scene: The BOX is LEFT of the CAT: place the closed box on the VIEWER LEFT and the cat on the VIEWER RIGHT. Both are fully visible side by side with a clear transparent gap, baseline aligned, same visual scale as other pair cards. No touching or overlap.
